reply_text:
I replied in #coastal-team, but I couldn't set up the recurring digest.

I don't have a way to schedule a post into Slack. My scheduler only saves output locally here, so nothing would appear in the channel on Mondays. I did not test a Slack-delivering schedule. My reply offers to post the digest by hand each Monday at 08:00 when someone asks, starting Monday 19 October. It covers #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus open customer items, and leaves out finance figures.
